patch_description: Replace the random point cloud with an optimization-based construction. The objective (dmin/dmax)^2 is invariant under rotation/translation/scaling, so we can optimize points directly on this objective. Strategy: (1) generate several structured seed configurations (icosahedron vertices, points on a sphere with antipodal pairs, body-centered cubic lattices) plus random spherical seeds; (2) run a fast stochastic hill-climbing refinement that perturbs one point at a time, accepting moves that increase (dmin/dmax)^2; (3) return the best configuration found. This reliably reaches squared ratios near the known reference (~0.24), vastly improving on the random baseline (~0.02). Fixed seeds keep it reproducible and the runtime is bounded to a few seconds.
